
```{r}

pos <- replicate(10000, sum(runif(16, -1, 1)))
```

```{r}
growth <- replicate(1000, prod(1 + runif(12, 0, 0.1)))
dens(growth, norm.comp=TRUE)
```

```{r}
big <- replicate(1000, prod(1 + runif(12, 0, 0.5)))
small <- replicate(1000, prod(1 + runif(12, 0, 0.01)))

dens(big, norm.comp=TRUE)
dens(small, norm.comp=TRUE)
```

```{r}
log_big <- replicate(1000, 
          log(prod(1 + runif(12, 0, 0.5))))

dens(log_big, norm.comp=TRUE)
```

```{r}

```

```{r}
str(d)
```

```{r}
precis(d)
```

```{r}
d2 <- d[d$age >= 18, ]
precis(d2)
```

```{r}
dens(d2$height)
```

```{r}
curve(dnorm(x, 178, 20), from = 100, to = 250)
curve(dunif(x, 0, 50), from = -10, to = 60)
```
```{r}
sample_mu <- rnorm(1e4, 178, 20)
sample_sigma <- runif(1e4, 0, 50)
prior_h <- rnorm(1e4, mean = sample_mu, sd = sample_sigma)
dens(prior_h)
```

```{r}
sample_mu2 <- rnorm(1e4, 178, 100)
prior_h2 <- rnorm(1e4, sample_mu2, sample_sigma)
dens(prior_h2)
```
